module.title: Final check
module.summary: Four questions covering all four objectives.

blocks.title: Question 1
blocks.accessibility: All content is available as text.

interaction.stem: Which of these is the strongest warning sign in an email from “HR”?

options.text: It asks you to sign in via a link to view an urgent salary change

interaction.feedbackCorrect: Correct: an urgent sign-in request via a link combines two warning signs.
interaction.feedbackIncorrect: Logos and timing are easy to fake or ordinary; the urgent sign-in request is the warning sign.
interaction.rationale: Urgency plus a credential request are agency-highlighted signs.

blocks.title: Question 2
blocks.accessibility: All content is available as text.

interaction.stem: An email shows none of the five warning signs but asks you to approve a large, unusual payment. What should you conclude?

options.text: It is safe because no signs are present
It still needs verifying, because the absence of signs is not proof of safety
Forward it to colleagues to see what they think

interaction.feedbackCorrect: Correct: the signs prompt checks; their absence does not clear a message.
interaction.feedbackIncorrect: Well-made phishing can show no signs. An unusual request still needs independent verification.
interaction.rationale: Absence of warning signs does not prove safety.

blocks.title: Question 3
blocks.accessibility: All content is available as text.

interaction.stem: Your “bank” texts and emails asking you to confirm a payment. How do you check?

options.text: Use the link in the email
Call the number on the back of your card

interaction.feedbackCorrect: Correct: a number you already hold is an independent channel.
interaction.feedbackIncorrect: Links and replies go back to the sender. Use a number you already hold.
interaction.rationale: Verify through a channel the sender cannot control.

blocks.title: Question 4
blocks.accessibility: All content is available as text.

interaction.stem: You realise you entered your password on a suspicious page. Order your next steps.

options.text: Change the password through the real site

interaction.feedbackCorrect: Correct: stop, report straight away, then change your password as instructed.
interaction.feedbackIncorrect: Stop first, report immediately so the team can act, then change your password.
interaction.rationale: Immediate reporting lets the security team contain the incident.
